slides.title: Scary stories for salon owners
slides.body: October edition. Don't read alone at the front desk.

slides.label: Chapter 1
slides.title: The license on the wall looks fine. Then you read the date.

slides.label: Chapter 2
slides.title: Your booth renter's license? You never actually checked.

slides.label: Chapter 3
slides.title: The insurance renewal email went to the receptionist who left in June.

slides.label: Chapter 4
slides.title: The inspector walks in.
slides.body: Every license is posted. You hope.

slides.label: The ending
slides.title: Sleep well. Every license date is written down.
slides.body: Yours, every stylist's, the shop's. Save this for your next license check.
